description: This Java class converts DittoRuntimeExceptions to appropriate ErrorResponse objects, differentiating by exception type and topic context. It handles policy and thing related errors by extracting entity IDs from topic paths or headers, and truncates headers for response size constraints.

classes.name: DittoRuntimeExceptionToErrorResponseFunction
classes.description: A final class that implements BiFunction to convert DittoRuntimeExceptions into ErrorResponse objects, handling headers truncation and entity ID extraction based on exception type and topic context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate the converter with a specified header size limit.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Converts a DittoRuntimeException into an ErrorResponse, selecting the response type based on exception class and topic path group.

methods.name: toThingErrorResponse
methods.description: Generates a ThingErrorResponse, extracting entity ID from topic path or headers.

methods.name: toPolicyErrorResponse
methods.description: Generates a PolicyErrorResponse, extracting entity ID from topic path or headers.
